name: witness-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; cp lean-kernel/library.ts "$OUT/library.ts"; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-witness.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/proof-witness.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): export retained witness source laws' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1

name: witness-simple
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; cp lean-kernel/library.ts "$OUT/library.ts"; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture witness-simple --sha256 84c3f25567e40ceb8f610eab3925f33b4fa5c4a3b75e2a738b54468a59224bef --out "$OUT/project" --projection witness > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/witness-source-verify.ts" "$OUT/project" "$OUT/lean.log" "$OUT/SOURCE-CHECKED.json" > "$OUT/source-check.log" 2>&1; rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"
